title: Private Berlin Complete History All Day Tour
description: Save time reading up on the history of Berlin and enjoy this comprehensive full-day history-themed tour instead—with a private guide for just your group. Along the way, enjoy insightful commentary and tick off a variety of famous sights, landmarks, and historical areas—including Brandenburg Gate, Checkpoint Charlie, the Berlin Wall Memorial, and the Reichstag Building.

reviews.usertext: We can't say enough good things about our walking tour of Berlin and our guide, Christian. It was an absolute highlight of our 2 weeks in Europe. Christian was extremely informative, professional, and friendly. We loved spending the day with him. He was able to answer all of our questions and more. He was a wealth of information about Berlin's history and culture, as well as the architecture of the city! My husband loves architecture so we really enjoyed this aspect of the tour. The 6 hours flew by and we would recommend this to anyone with an interest in history and getting to know the city of Berlin better.

We enjoyed a private walking tour of Berlin on September 17 with Rebecca. We were a group of 4 and thoroughly enjoyed our time in Berlin with our tour guide Rebecca. We had about 4 hours only to cover the highlights of the city and Rebecca made sure our tour was comprehensive and thorough for the time allotted. Rebecca was excellent, extremely knowledgeable of her Berlin history, and passionate in her delivery. Highly recommend this tour...and doing as a small group rather than joining a larger tour. You gain much greater insight into the city and current economy, policy, politics, etc.

We really loved this tour! If you have one solid day in Berlin this tour is a must. We learned so much and saw SO many great things. I didn’t expect to learn so much. And it was a very nice walking day. You really can get to many of the must-sees in one day of walking. At the end of the day our guide even took us into an authentic German restaurant and made sure we could be seated without a reservation. We were able to take many great photos of our day!

Consider yourself fortunate if you have Sarah as your guide. Extremely personable, knowledgeable, and insightful. She and her “Bible” of images of pre-war and -post-war Berlin brought our tour to life. Sarah made sure we saw everything we wanted to, even some places off the beaten path. Our six + hours with her went by too quickly. Well worth the money!

Our guide, Aaron, was a pleasure to be with and was excellent about communicating with me in the days leading up to our tour. Due some staffing issues, our private tour for 2 turned into a group of 6, but it was really not an issue. Aaron is incredibly knowledgeable about the history of Germany, and clearly explained about everything we saw in Berlin. He has a great personality and added a lot of wit and charm into his presentation. He is clearly a passionate historian. I would highly recommend this tour for anyone wanting to get an accurate and intense representation of the highlights of Berlin.

We booked two private tours with Birchy’s Berlin on our recent trip, and both were fantastic.
Aaron spent 6 hours showing us round the city, and Paul took us out to Sachenhausen. Both were great guides. Interesting and cheerful and very personable, it was like having a (really knowledgeable) friend for the day. They also gave us welcome pointers for where to go and food to try on the remaining days of our trip. (yes we loved Burgermeister)
Would thoroughly recommend

Our guide was Francisco, a Chilean architecture student who has lived in Berlin for a number of years. He was incredibly knowledgeable about German and Berlin history (and architecture!), did a wonderful job of explaining what we were seeing and the history behind it, and was a delightful companion for the day. We particularly appreciated that he tailored the day toward sights we had not yet seen, added several interesting places not on the standard itinerary, and taught us much we did not know about life in what was formerly East Berlin. The walking pace was easy, with stops whenever we wanted for coffee or just a short rest, and Francisco’s pleasant enthusiasm never lagged for a moment. Overall, a terrific day with a superb guide, vastly better than any group tour we might have done, and worth every minute and Euro we spent. We rarely write glowing reviews, but here it is deserved. In our view, the way to see Berlin.

We spent a very enjoyable day with our guide, Rebecca, who was as knowledgeable of the history and culture of Berlin, as she was friendly, warm and considerate toward everyone of our party of 4 (2 parents and a 10 year old daughter and 12 year old son).

We did the tour on our 2nd full day in Berlin so had visited some of the locations the day before but having a guide to tell the story of the locations we visited really helped bring the story to life, and particularly for the 2 children who were less inclined to read about the places we visited.

We had never done a private tour like this before but definitely would again.

Sarah, our guide, was wonderful. She was very knowledgeable and prepared for the tour. She had a portfolio of photos to show areas / buildings pre-war & post-war. Sarah was especially cognizant of the background noise during her tour talks and also aware of anything that may cause difficulties to our walk about the city. Thanks

Great day with Paul wandering around Berlin and learning lots. Fabulous pace with a beautifully curated set of sights that built up a picture of the history of Berlin. The 6 hours flew by and it was great value for money for a private tour for two. We’ll be booking another once whenever we are back in Berlin!

Paul Tobin was an amazing tour guide. He is very knowledgeable and has explained everything clearly. The tour was beautiful and very interesting as WW2 had an incredible influence on the future and arcitexture of the city but is still noticable as most of the buildings in east berlin are stil standing since the war, wheather they were rebuild or not.
All in all, the tour was fanatstic and I highly reccomend booking this tour.

Francisco was our fantastic guide for the 6.5 hour private tour. We had a great time learning about the main historic landmarks in Berlin. Francisco was really knowledgeable, enthusiastic and funny. The picture is of one of the alleyways he left us to explore at the end of the tour - "a city within a city". Strongly recommended!

We had Aaron and his knowledge of everything from the 19th century, to WWII, to the unification of East and West (and more!) was very impressive. We learned so much walking around Berlin and will remember this tour as one of our favorite historical tours in Europe! Aaron and the company were extremely accommodating (we flew in the night prior and the airline lost our luggage). They quickly responded to our late night request to delay our meet time so we could have time prior to the tour to buy some clothes to keep us warm. Overall, this was a very memorable experience and I would recommend Aaron in a heartbeat to anyone visiting Berlin and eager to learn some fascinating history!

I loved my tour with Beth! A historical researcher with a Master's in history, specifically nazi-era Germany, she had so many interesting facts and stories ranging from the beginning of berlin in the 1200s to the end of the cold war. She took me to many sites over the course of my 6 hour tour and moved at a pace easily maintained. My favorite part of the tour was the Brandenburg gate with the victory statue eyeballing the French embassy lol. Overall was a lovely day spent with a very intelligent and personable woman. Would absolutely recommend!

Our guide was very knowledgeable, very interesting and funny! My 11 year old son and me both loved the tour. Tour guide kept telling us about every site, showing us laminated photos, educating us the whole day on everything we saw. He answered all of my sons many, many questions (with a smile). He was truly a wonderful tour guide and I would highly, highly recommend him! It was the perfect tour and the most perfect tour guide!

We had an excellent tour! Paul led us throughout the city, and even in the rain, we had the best day! We saw all of the major sites, and Paul provided interesting historical background information and tidbits of cultural points, that made Berlin come alive. It is an amazing city anyway, but Paul just made it that much more interesting. So much more, that we plan to return to spend more time there. We would totally recommend this tour, along with Paul as the perfect tour guide. We travel quite extensively, and have gone on many city tours. This certainly ranks up as one of the top tourist we’ve ever taken. Put on your tennis shoes; you’ll be doing a lot of walking!

Paul was an awesome tour guide. He knew so much about the city. Our original guide got COVID, so we were put together with another 2-person group, and it worked out just great, and half our money was refunded. We learned so much about Berlin. Thank you Paul!

Paul guided us through the highlights of Berlin focusing on WWII, as that is what my son was most interested in seeing. That being said, Paul was able to put things in a historical context that made the information easy to understand. He also explained how historical and current day Berlin fit together.

He also answered all of my tedious questions about everything from university housing to medical care.

I would definitely recommend this tour for the first day in Berlin to get an understanding of what else to see and do in Berlin.

Myself and my sister attended a walking tour with Paul with another group. The walking tour was really outstanding, so much historical detail was provided. The tour was informative, at a steady pace and Paul had printed of pictures to aid the walking tour to give context to everything. Paul is very knowledgeable, and his attention to detail was very on point. I wouldn't hesitate in recommending Birchys tour as we really had the best day. It is the best way to see Berlin.

Private tour of Berlin history with our amazing guide Paul. Full of knowledge and very personable. With a private guide we were able to ask questions as they came up whether they were on or off topic. Would highly recommend the tour and even better if you’re able to get Paul as your guide.

Francisco was fantastic. He was knowledgeable and hospitable. After a short period of time he was just one of the family. He ran the tour in English but since we had some Spanish speakers in our family he was also flexible and accommodating to them. As an architect, he was also able to add a lot of knowledge additional to the historical context. There is a lot of walking on this tour but it is thoughtfully laid out to have the right number of stops for coffee or just to break and get more information. The tour is also flexible enough to make any stops necessary. We highly recommend this tour for anyone who has the 6 hours to spare. You cover a lot of ground and information in a short period of time.

Thank you!

Three cheers for Hannah. First half day in Berlin was ok but not memorable. Then we spent about 7 hours with Hannah on a private guided tour. We learned more in one day than we could have learned in a semester of college. Her American accent was especially helpful with our ability to retain her vast wealth of knowledge. Our time spent with Hannah was worth every single dollar paid for the tour. We highly recommend her.

Paul was our tour guide and was excellent. We had limited time and he took us to all the major sites, had great insight into each site, and was very accommodating. We wanted some authentic food and he made sure we got our fill. Overall very please, reasonably priced and very worth it!

The tour offered a very insightful perspective. We had time to see, discuss, and even exchange points of view. The guide tools us to see not only historical sites but memorials that enriched further more the experience. Beth was everything and more we expected from a tour guide. Very knowledgeable, great senses of humor, and very flexible. This is the tour for someone looking to get a good baseline - knowledge in 6hrs. This tour rates 5 stars in my book.

I’ve done a lot of private tours before, but few if any came as close as this one to blending the historical depth, cultural breadth and good time fun. This tour was spot on. I’m a huge WW2 history nut with a wild rebel personality and I found more than my match in my guide. We had such a blast. He was fun, knowledgeable, flexible and personal. Time and money we’ll spent!

We had a great tour with Jules this week. She was informative, really knew her stuff, and gave an honest and personal account of Berlin life now and in the past. She was the perfect combo of history nerd and normal human. We got on so well that bits of it didn’t feel like a tour at all (in a good way!) it was definitely very tailored to us and conversational throughout. We’d recommend this tour to anyone - thanks so much.

Great tour guided by Paul. We were a group of 5 and had a fantastic day. Paul was super friendly and very knowledgeable on all aspects of German history and culture. The time flew by and we came away with a better appreciation of Berlin and broader German history as well as some good pointers on sites and activities to explore on our own time. Thoroughly recommend the tour.

My 3 travel companions and I had a full day walking tour of Berlin with Aaron.We learned so much about the entire history of Berlin from its beginning to the present day. Aaron was extremely well informed and made the history understandable - his knowledge was vast and deep. He was able to answer any questions we had often in detail. His presentation was interesting and while he had a great sense of humor, he was also respectful of the history he was presenting to us. We all agreed we would highly recommend him as a tour guide. Thank you so much for making the complex history of Berlin interesting, compelling and understandable!

This tour was excellent! Much better than we had expected. The guide Steve Gibson was very knowledgeable (ex maths teacher). I usually use Tour by locals. This was much less expensive and very very good.

One of the best tour experiences we’ve had. Berlin is a nice city with lots of history and with Aaron as our guide, we got a chance to relive some that history. Highly recommended. Give them a chance; you won’t be disappointed.

Just finished a Family tour with 4 (2 children 13 and 8). Paul was outstanding. Never felt rushed and moved at our pace. Gave us plenty of options and was great with my kids-who had so many questions, that even I got annoyed.

Rebecca was so patient with my three children, ages 12, 10 and 8. She also was extremely accommodating with my mom who doesn’t move around as well and walks slowly. We had an amazing tour learning as much history as we could fit into 6 hours. I cannot recommend Rebecca enough! It was one of the best tours I have ever been on.

Paul was our tourguide, very nice guy with a lot of Knowledge! We did this amazing private tour on our first day, so we got to know the city better, so we knew what to do the next coming days. He recommended so many great spots in Berlin. If you don’t know anything in Berlin, you have to take this tour first, is so nice! You get to know so much cool stuf, that you wouldn’t know if you walk by or don’t know where to go! Thank you Paul!

Fantastic all day tour with Stephen. Think Eddie Izzard with an Australian accent. Provided detailed historical information with humor and perspective. Best way to see the city and get your bearings. I would very highly recommend.

Brilliant!! The whole day was so informative, everything went at our pace and Paul Tobin was such a great guide. Fantastic mix of knowledge, humour and informal chat. Would highly recommend him and this tour .

What an incredible tour we had with Francisco, he made our holiday! Such a down to earth and friendly guy, full of knowledge and passion. We spent the day with him and there is nothing this guy doesn't know about Berlin. If you book this tour, make sure you ask for Francisco, he is the best. Craig and Jade

We had a fantastic full day private tour with our guide Steve. It was a multifaceted learning experience with the broad history of Berlin and Germany, war history and pop culture. Steve was fun and immensely entertaining throughout.

We had an amazing day with Paul. He has an incredible knowledge of the country and answers all of our questions. It was an excellent closure of our trip to Germany. We highly recommend this tour! We will book another one when we plan to return.

Our guide was Paul, he met us at the hotel and our tour started then as we walked to public transportation he stopped and shared details about the local area. He made it clear if we need a break at anytime to let him know, he kept the tour at a casual pace. I would Highly recommend Paul as a guide.

Francisco was an incredible guide and made this walk through history worth every step . HIs knowledge of current affairs and his in-depth understanding of Berlin made this experience worth getting wet. We managed to get through most places on the list and added a few more places according to my interest. Francisco was respectful, patient and flexible. HIs friendly nature allowed me to get through so much in one day. Thank you for the extra care and kindness.

We really enjoyed Francisco and his tour! A great way to explore the highlights of Berlin! Even despite the rain! Francisco was very polite and always made sure we were seeing and doing what we wanted!
Paul was extremely knowledgeable and nice. We had the best experience. Highly recommend. It’s a walking tour so prepare with comfortable shoes
Our guide Paulhad a European History Masters and was very knowledgeable. He was very accommodating and went at the pace we wanted. Definitely recommend this tour.

Our guide, Paul, was informative and engaging! He was incredibly knowledgeable about the city, while also adept at answering our many questions! We would absolutely recommend this tour to anyone visiting the city :)

It was awesome! We got way more then I thought we would!
Paul was the greatest! A lot of knowledge and spot on on every sight!

A very interesting and professional tour guide . Paul had a thorough knowledge of Berlin and kept the interest of the whole group during the trip.
A very flexible schedule with time for breaks when needed.
Excellent all day tour of Berlin. Guide was Paul. He was very professional as guide and could answer any question we had. Very flexibel tour where we could take toilet/food breaks as we needed.

This was the longest history/educational tour we have ever taken, also the BEST! Our tour guide was Paul, he was prompt, patient and most importantly knowledgeable. There were three adults and four kids (ages 12, 12, 11 & 10) in our group. We were concerned that the kids would get bored and tired on such a long tour but Paul was able to captivate not only the kids but us adults as well.

We loved our time in Berlin! Thanks Paul for a great day!
Loved our guide, Paul. He was so knowledgeable & friendly. We went at our pace & stopped when we needed to stop. He was so accommodating.

My tour guide Paul Tobin was exceptional! He really had a command of the city, and was great to person to chat with about the history of Berlin. I strong recommend that you use this service as they only hire the best!

Booked this trip to see the sights and learn the history of Berlin. Our tour guide Aaron was fantastic! He has lived in Berlin for 10 years and he was exteamly knowledgable and friendly.
Really enjoyed it and would highly recommend.
He even gave us recommendations on places to eat and drink which we tried and really enjoyed.
Paul was an excellent guide - really knowledgeable but friendly and accessible. We have a great whole day tour and was engaged throughout. Can’t recommend him highly enough. Thanks Paul!

We had an amazing time with Paul our guide, it was one of the best tours I had in my life, guide on time, polite, knew everything about country history and culture, had no rush at all, stayed with us whole day, it was amazing!!!

My husband and I had seen WWII sights in Berlin on earlier tours and wanted a broader perspective. Our guide, Francisco, an architect with an interest in urban planning was fantastic. Even though we’re in our 70s the 7 hrs went by so fast. Francisco explained the history of Berlin by pointing out the architecture, street design, and why buildings were made of certain materials. We visited monuments and he explained why they were created. WWI and WWII sights were described as to their purpose, Why and if they are being preserved, how do they preserve the past without glorifying the ugly history associated with them. I especially enjoyed learning so much about divided Berlin, east vs west. Francisco has wonderful stories, many anecdotes and a strong knowledge of history. Strongly recommend a tour with Francisco!!

What a great way to learn about the history of Berlin! Paul, was such a good tour guide, patient, answered all of our questions and just made the day fun. We walked all over Berlin and we really learned all about the history of the city. Even my wife who is not a big history buff, loved this tour. 10/10, highly recommend!

We had the best tour with Aaron! It was obvious that he was passionate and knowledgeable about the sites; we learned so much! Would highly recommend this tour if you are interested in the history of this beautiful city along with seeing the sites.
Julian was a great guide! Really helped us to appreciate the history of Berlin. From the start of the city in 1247 to down to right now.
Our guide Julian was very knowledgeable and gave us a through history of the area. We were able to see all of the sights and really enjoyed our tour. We stayed an extra day to visit the museums.
Great guide Steve Gibson. A lot of Knowledge about Berlin and a very cool guy. From 1237 to nowadays a great overview over Berlin.

Hanna, our guide, was exceptional! Her "California accent" was refreshing and her MS in history more than prepared her for the task.
She walked us every where we wanted and we learned more about Berlin and German history during the day with her than we could ever imagine! Absolutely perfect day!
A great day learning the history and locales in Berlin. Enjoyed the walk and seeing the landmarks of Berlin with local knowledge.

Out guide steve was fantastic a real character
He was a wealth of knowledge and answered all questions asked of him and more
Sign up now ask for steve from Australia !!!!!!!
Have no clue how good it is because it got canceled due to the tour guide testing positive for covid. The company did offer alternatives but neither worked for us.
I recommend Francisco, our guide. We had a wonderful day in Berlin because of him. The stories and history were presented in a sensational style, full of interesting information.
Jules was completely amazing. They arranged a special meeting time due to my schedule. Will use them again.
Excellent tour covering all the major sites throughout Berlin. Our guide was very knowledgeable in the history of all sites. We would highly recommend.

Aaron was a most informative and knowledgeable guide. He was also flexible enough to debate some challenging questions.
We thoroughly enjoyed the 6 hours. The time flew by.
We had a wonderful tour with Aaron! He was incredibly knowledgeable and passionate. The tour was informative and fun, and I highly recommend the tour experience to all visiting Berlin.
Great tour of Berlin, we got to see all the major sites. Aaron was knowledgeable and great tour guide
We took an Amazing history tour with Ken. I would highly suggest this your for anyone visiting the city for the first time. Thanks so much!
